(1) CONTRADICTION: it prescribed roving tabindex on <tr> while its own parenthetical banned nested focusables per a11y-plan section 11 — but every row already contains an Investigate button, so a focusable row containing a focusable button is exactly the banned shape. Implemented without the per-row announce.

the plan offered two options for the lint:a11y repair and the FIRST is structurally impossible, which neither phase research nor the a11y extract could have known without running it: eslint --rule builds a TOP-LEVEL flat-config object, but the jsx-a11y plugin is declared only inside the files:[**/*.{ts,tsx,jsx}] block, so `eslint . --rule jsx-a11y/alt-text:error` fails with "could not find plugin jsx-a11y" (exit 2) even after the Windows quoting is fixed.
